answer: Each agent must recompute a unique pigment hash from an umber public seed blended with private hardware entropy every epoch, then answer a zephyr-timed challenge that re-derives the same hash under latency bounds. Shared machines collide on pigment, so a farm must provision separate hosts; at market cloud rates that is about 70 dollars per identity per month with zero bulk discount. Graders recompute the hash from the ledger seed and reject mismatches.
